metas.name: About Us
metas.description: Five friends navigate crises and complications as they face the challenges of adult life.

metas.name: Lilas Dreams & Memories
metas.description: Singer-songwriter Rira Ikuta travels to Salt Lake City—the iconic setting of *High School Musical*, a film that significantly influenced her artistic career—and then to Los Angeles, home to the world’s very first Disneyland. This travel and music documentary follows her as she pursues new dreams as an artist.

metas.name: The Remarried Empress
metas.description: Beloved Empress Navier rules the Eastern Empire alongside Emperor Sovieshu. But when Sovieshu falls for a runaway slave and demands a divorce, Navier will agree on one condition: that she's given approval to remarry rival Prince Heinrey of the Western Kingdom.

metas.name: Locker Diaries: Coven Academy
metas.description: Peer inside the halls of Coven Academy and discover the supernatural secrets that unfold in the lives of its students.

metas.name: Marrakech Comedy Festival
metas.description: Conceived and hosted by Malik Bentalha, this new comedy event will bring together a mix of established stand-up comedians and up-and-coming talent on the stage of the Palais des Congrès!

metas.name: PodDelas no Walt Disney World Resort
VisionQuest
metas.description: With a bounty on his head, Vision must confront his nature and resist Ultron's influence to survive.

metas.name: Locker Diaries: Camp Rock
metas.description: ‪Glimpse the drama unfolding across Camp Rock.‬

metas.name: Yacht Deals Monaco
metas.description: Ambitious sales talents compete in Monaco for a life-changing job in the world of luxury yachts. Under the guidance of yacht broker Cornelius Kistler and yacht consultant Marcela de Kern Royer, they face demanding tasks, high-end clients, and intense eliminations.

metas.name: Food Samouraï
metas.description: Sacko Mory immerses himself in Japanese culture and gastronomy to unlock how to prepare the perfect bento.

metas.name: Deadly Tag
metas.description: A brutal chase for survival across a vast battlefield where no one can be trusted and only the last one standing wins.

metas.name: Addicted
metas.description: Each character’s unbreakable addiction stems from unresolved life issues. To avenge herself against the scumbag WANG Fei-Peng, Casey ZHANG quietly approaches his alcohol-addicted wife, YANG Man-ru. Unexpectedly, they become close friends despite their age difference and embark on a path of drug abuse. Anti-narcotics officer CHEN Qi-ming, while investigating the case, reunites with his first love, YANG Man-ru. Their unresolved feelings lead to his guilt and struggle. Their obsessive attachments, akin to addiction, drag them into their own abysses.

metas.name: The Real Rooneys
metas.description: A candid glimpse into the Rooneys' world as soccer legend Wayne juggles dad duties and former England captain's wife Coleen balances motherhood with business ambitions.

metas.name: City of Blood
metas.description: Berlin — a city-state on the brink. While a privileged few live beneath a climate-controlled dome, those outside struggle to survive in a world ravaged by heat, corruption, and crime. After years apart, sisters Bea and Phoebe are reunited and uncover a dark secret: Vampires are determined to seize political power — and blood has become the city's new currency.

metas.name: Unexpected Loves
metas.description: What do a thief, a tennis coach, a nurse, and a tollbooth worker all have in common? Coming from unique plots and a variety of characters, in each episode Martín Bossi plays a different protagonist, someone in search of an unexpected love story.

metas.name: Minimum Security
metas.description: Corinne runs Chénoise prison with her unlikely team: By-the-book Jeff, JP who's always been closer to inmates than colleagues, and rookie Stéphanie.

metas.name: Countdown to Avengers: Doomsday Official Podcast
metas.description: Iman Vellani and Frank Alvarez host a rewatch of films from Marvel Studios' The Infinity Saga, working their way to Avengers: Doomsday. Together, they revisit each film with a recap and a conversation about which themes and characters may continue to have future implications.

metas.name: My Name Is Gutierrez
metas.description: Deputy Commissioner Gutierrez competes with the CIA to solve the murder of the Russian Ambassador with his unique style.

metas.name: Pod Meets World
metas.description: Danielle Fishel, Will Friedle and Rider Strong are back for a new era on Pod Meets World!

metas.name: THE ONE SHOT
metas.description: Eight of Japan's top comedians selected by Daigo, including M-1 finalists and King of Conte champions, must each write and direct a short film with just one rule: include a single, hilarious gag. In this unprecedented competition, skilled comedians have just "one shot" to prove their true talent.

metas.name: Mickey Mouse Clubhouse+: Mickey's Country Farm Songs
metas.description: Join Mickey and his friends for brand-new adventures filled with songs, fun, togetherness, and funny surprises.

metas.name: Murder Club: Liar's Table
metas.description: A competitive mystery-variety series fusing deduction, role-play, and entertainment. Each episode drops the cast into a murder case as characters who gather clues, hold secret talks, and complete the story themselves—from the opening crime through character intros, clue rounds, interviews, a final vote, and the ending.

metas.name: Locker Diaries: Descendants
metas.description: Glimpse the drama happening in the school hallways of Auradon Prep and discover the secret adventures that unfold.

metas.name: Soy Luna: Let's Roll Again
metas.description: After an accident that sidelined her, Luna returns to her beloved Jam & Roller. Putting on her skates again won't be easy, especially when a hidden villain's plan starts to complicate her life. She'll also face a dilemma, torn between old flames. Amidst songs, adventures, and reunions with friends, Luna will have to overcome many obstacles to fulfill her dream.

metas.name: Bluey Compilations
metas.description: In this series of compilations, Bluey uses her limitless energy to play games that unfold in hilarious ways, bringing her family and the whole neighborhood into her world of fun.

metas.name: Olivia
metas.description: The country's most famous weatherman must seek refuge from a media storm with his daughter Olivia in his father's olive grove. But having not spoken to him for 30 years won't make returning to his roots easy.

metas.name: The Doomies
metas.description: When best friends Bobby and Romy mistakenly open up a gateway to another world, they turn their sleepy coastal town into a hotspot for terrifying creatures of doom. Roped into an epic supernatural mystery, they will cross paths with the so-called “Chosen One” and do battle with both literal and inner monsters.

metas.name: King & Prince: Our Meet-Up in LA
metas.description: Ren Nagase and Kaito Takahashi of King & Prince have always been by each other's side. In Los Angeles, they celebrate their bond with a uniquely themed adventure. The once inseparable pair must now part ways to complete a series of challenges before finding their way back to each other. This is the real Ren and Kaito, off-duty and offstage. Join them on their heartfelt journey across the United States and experience the simple joy of finally meeting up again.

metas.name: Alice and Steve
metas.description: Alice is devastated when her best friend Steve starts dating her 26-year-old daughter Izzy. She's going to lose her best friend and her daughter in one fell swoop. Alice tries everything she can to end the relationship. Unfortunately for her, Steve's more than ready for the attack, and what begins as a perfect friendship, devolves into an all-out feud.

metas.name: Abandoned
metas.description: In 1984, three children were abandoned at a Barcelona train station with no memory of their identity or past. Unclaimed, they were adopted into loving homes. As adults, they now search for their biological parents.

metas.name: World Wide Mafia, 'Ndrangheta
metas.description: Prosecutor Nicola Gratteri fights against the ’Ndrangheta, the world’s most powerful mafia, in this true story. From the Rinascita Scott operation to the historic Maxi-Trial, the series unveils courage, justice, and sacrifice in a relentless fight against organized crime.

metas.name: Rivals: The Official Podcast
metas.description: Hosted by Pandora Sykes, this podcast brings listeners inside the world of “Rivals” through conversations with its onscreen stars, including David Tennant, Aidan Turner, and Emily Atack, alongside the executive producers and creative team. Joined by celebrity guests and Dame Jilly Cooper superfans, the podcast explores the rivalries, scandals, and drama that define Rutshire.

metas.name: Sofia the First: Magical Friends
metas.description: Welcome to the Charmswell School for Royal Magic! Spend time with Sofia and her Royal Friends, where she takes you on a sparkling tour of her brand-new royal school, where every castle shines with its own special kind of magic. Along the way, she'll introduce you to her old and new friends - Pepper, Clover, Layla, Zane, and Camila - each with amazing talents and magical gifts of their own. With Sofia as your guide, there's no better way to discover the magic of Charmswell!

metas.name: Travis Japan Summer Vacation!! in the USA
metas.description: Travis Japan embarks on a summer road trip through the Rocky Mountains in North America. Divided into teams, one hits the road by RV, the other dives into local culture. With new horizons to explore and heartfelt connections to make, this road trip promises to be unlike any other.

metas.name: Gold Land
metas.description: A young woman working as an airport security agent accidentally comes into possession of a smuggling ring’s gold bars. Caught in a chaotic whirlwind of greed and betrayal among various parties vying for the gold, she becomes consumed by the desire to claim it all for herself.

metas.name: Casa do Patrão
metas.description: The new reality show follows the daily coexistence of anonymous participants inside three houses: the Boss’s House, the Work House, and the Coexistence House. In this dynamic, decisions, privileges, and responsibilities constantly reshape the group. Hosted by Leandro Hassum, the show promises to answer the question: does power change people, or does it simply reveal who they have always been?

metas.name: La nena
metas.description: Months after the events of The Purple Network, the hunt is not over yet. Following Lucas's death, Elena Blanco has disappeared. Only Mariajo knows where she is, but she keeps it a secret, even from the rest of the team. The fight against The Network has taken too much of a toll on her, and in a desperate attempt to get her life back on track, she has left the BAC.

metas.name: Star Wars: Maul - Shadow Lord
metas.description: After the Clone Wars, Maul plots to rebuild his criminal syndicate on a planet untouched by the Empire.

metas.name: Raising Chelsea
metas.description: An intimate three-part series following the former Made in Chelsea stars, Jamie Laing and Sophie Habboo, as they face the messy, scary and hilarious reality of becoming parents.

metas.name: Donna Hay Coastal Celebrations
metas.description: Best-selling Australian cookbook author, Donna Hay hosts a series of sunny celebrations by the sea, where she styles and cooks delicious food in beautiful locations. With Sydney’s harbour as the backdrop, Donna uses fresh produce to create simple and stunning food.

metas.name: If It's Tuesday, It's Murder
metas.description: A diverse group of tourists on an organized trip to Lisbon find themselves investigating a murder after one of them is killed on the first morning.

metas.name: We'll Be Fine
metas.description: Aktan and Lal, two polar opposites who meet at a party, find themselves caught up in a grand love story. Their fairytale romance spirals into chaos as they change everything in their lives to be together.

metas.name: Lucky Luke
metas.description: Lucky Luke, the legendary lone cowboy, must team up with Louise, a fearless young woman searching for her missing mother. Together, they face the dangers of the Wild West, ally with old enemies like the Daltons or Billy the Kid - and learn to get along. This quest may reveal a far greater threat and lead Luke back to the origins of his legend.

metas.name: IC - Investigação Criminal
metas.description: In this series, you'll delve into the behind-the-scenes stories of cases that shocked and divided the country, following the reconstruction of the truth from the perspective of those who lived through the events firsthand. Prepare to revisit emblematic crimes and understand how every detail, every piece of evidence, and every contradiction helps transform suspicions into answers.

metas.name: O11CE: New Generation
metas.description: After six years of success in European soccer, Gabo, Dedé, and Ricky decide to visit IAD, the Academic Sports Institute, which saw them grow up, and surprise them. But they are the ones who get the surprise: the IAD is not as it used to be and the Golden Hawks, the soccer team they were part of, is aimless, unmotivated, and on the verge of being relegates. Now they must restore the IAD’s glory and the pride of being an Hawk: a new chapter begins, full of passion and plenty of soccer!

metas.name: Daredevil: Born Again Official Podcast
metas.description: The "Daredevil: Born Again" cast and crew sit down to discuss Season 2's thrilling twists and turns.

metas.name: Friends Like These: The Murder of Skylar Neese
metas.description: Follows the investigation into the 2012 murder of West Virginia teen Skylar Neese, whose closest friends were implicated in her death, examining friendship and betrayal in the digital age.

metas.name: The Zoo
metas.description: Sunny Chu, a Group Creative Director at a global ad agency, is a master of high-pressure environments—until everything starts falling apart. She loses a major client, gets sidelined at work, and her relationship takes a hit. Her last shot at redemption comes in the form of rebranding a zoo. But there’s a catch: she must first work as a zookeeper intern. Thrown into a world of demanding animals, endless cleaning, and eccentric coworkers—especially the aloof senior keeper Shaun Su—Sunny must forget everything she knows about office politics and learn to survive by the rules of the wild.

metas.name: Locker Diaries: ZOMBIES
metas.description: Glimpse the drama happening in the school hallways of Shadyside & Sunnyside and discover the secret adventures that unfold.

metas.name: Battle of Fates
metas.description: Is our fate predetermined? And can anyone truly read it? A groundbreaking competition dares to find out. Korea's top 49 top Fate Readers—masters of shamanism, saju, tarot, and face reading—put their pride on the line. Only those who can genuinely read fate will survive. Who will be the winner?

metas.name: Bloody Flower
metas.description: A former medical school dropout claiming to be able to cure terminal illnesses is sentenced to death for the murder of 17 people. Is he a monstrous killer, or a savior holding the cure for humanity?

metas.name: Wonder Man
metas.description: Simon and Trevor, two actors at opposite ends of their careers, chase life-changing roles.

metas.name: Dipeul-ui Ibpeul-i
metas.description: Catch all the juicy spills, secrets, and stories behind the shows and films on Disney+.

metas.name: Agent P Under C
metas.description: Perry the Platypus battles an evil animal agent working for ANATHEMA (the Alliance of Nefarious Animals That Has an Exceptionally Memorable Acronym).

metas.name: Haunted House Secrets
metas.description: What kind of story lies behind each wounded soul?” Follow the “Haunted House Specialty Shop” as they visit haunted houses and explore the stories behind them. The emotions left behind in these houses—anger, sadness, reluctance, regret—reflect the challenges faced by A-Ze and his companions. As they resolve each soul’s lingering obsession, they also overcome their own obstacles and continue moving forward.

metas.name: Made in Korea
metas.description: In 1970s South Korea, follow two men on opposite sides of power — one driven by ambition, the other by justice. As their worlds collide, greed, loyalty, and survival intertwine in a battle that will shape a nation.

metas.name: The End of an Era
metas.description: A behind-the-scenes docuseries event chronicling the development, impact, and inner workings that created the phenomenon that was Taylor Swift | The Eras Tour, as well as providing an intimate look at Taylor's life as her tour made headlines and thrilled fans around the world. The series also spotlights performers, family members, and friends — including Gracie Abrams, Sabrina Carpenter, Ed Sheeran, and Florence Welch — offering never-before-seen insight into what it took to create a phenomenon.

metas.name: Percy Jackson and the Olympians Official Podcast
metas.description: Hosted by Aryan Simhadri, it features behind-the-scenes stories, cast and crew interviews (including Rick Riordan), and fun insights that celebrate the world and fandom of Percy Jackson.

metas.name: Daughter of Fire
metas.description: A foreign woman returns to her hometown with another identity. Her presence raises suspicions, but no one imagines the truth: she is the key piece of a bloody revenge. Having everyone's trust, she puts her plan into action and commits the most brutal crimes in a town that hides more secrets than it seems.

metas.name: The Eighth Family
metas.description: With their invention of bulletproof thermal underwear, the Basmacıgil Family earns the title of the Eighth Family, one of the ruling forces of the world. Yet, as six very different siblings attempt to run the family business, their well-meaning but ineffective efforts leave their father Erol convinced that “no outside enemy is necessary."

metas.name: LEGO Marvel Avengers: Strange Tails
metas.description: Hawkeye and The Avengers have made saving the world look easy. But now they face their wildest threat yet: SOCIAL MEDIA. To save the world, a new team must be recruited to help our heroes contend with an influencer bent on cataclysmic destruction.

metas.name: Caroline Flack: Search for the Truth
metas.description: Follow Caroline's mother, Christine, as she investigates the truth about her daughter's final months - uncovering new shocking details, asking difficult questions, and exposing the misrepresentations, pressures, and failures from institutions and decision makers that shaped Caroline's final days.

metas.name: The Worst Trip Around the World
metas.description: Having no clue about what traveling around the world entails, Juanpa Zurita convinces Disney+ that he can do it with just a small plane and legendary pilot Matt Guthmiller. Traveling to eight destinations across four continents, with eight celebrity guests to make sure he wouldn’t fail alone, and a small budget he managed to get from Disney, it was inevitable this would turn into a complete disaster.

metas.name: Fire and Water: Making the Avatar Films
metas.description: This two-part documentary provides a fascinating glimpse into the making of the Oscar-winning box office phenomenon "Avatar: The Way of Water" and features exclusive behind-the-scenes footage, concept art, and interviews with cast and filmmakers.

metas.name: SEVENTEEN: OUR CHAPTER
metas.description: Answers discovered through endless questioning, never-ending challenges and performances, and the stories shared with CARATs. This 10th-anniversary documentary series captures SEVENTEEN's candid stories.

metas.name: The Manipulated
metas.description: Taejoong's life is torn apart when he's framed for a heinous crime and imprisoned. Discovering it was all orchestrated by someone on the outside, he embarks on a rage-fueled quest for revenge.

metas.name: Fortnite x The Simpsons
metas.description: Springfield and Fortnite universes converge. Chaos ensues as Homer sets out to transform the world, wielding a powerful alien energy.

metas.name: Playback: Together We Are One
metas.description: Best friends Emma and Camila dream of becoming musicians despite family burdens—Emma can’t sing after her father’s death, and Camila’s family forbids her from singing due to a hidden secret. When they fake a performance for a talent show, their success sparks fame, rivalry, and the risk of exposing Camila’s secret and their friendship.

metas.name: Disney Twisted-Wonderland: The Animation
metas.description: High school student Yuken is suddenly transported to Twisted Wonderland, a world of magic and wonder. Now, he must face monsters, whimsical magicians-in-training, and mysterious incidents, all without any magic of his own. Will Yu ever find a way back to his own world?

metas.name: Entrepreneurs
metas.description: Gonzalo, a bar owner's son, keeps failing at nightlife ventures funded by his father. Given one last chance with a new space, he partners with a self-proclaimed guru to open a coworking space, supervised by his sister Julia.

metas.name: "Couch" by Lena Situations
metas.description: On her iconic pink couch, Lena Situations welcomes artists, creators, and personalities from all over the world for genuine, funny, and inspiring conversations.

metas.name: To Cook a Bear
metas.description: In Northern Sweden, 1852, a new pastor and his family arrive in Kengis, a village riddled with disorder.

metas.name: Fate
metas.description: Taxi driver David becomes the chauffeur for a famous bullfighter known as El Maestro, who is attempting a comeback after years away from the ring. El Maestro's perspective changes, and he starts seeing David as a good luck charm.

metas.name: The Lost Station Girls
metas.description: Between 1995 and 2001 in southern France, a teenage girl vanishes and three young women are murdered—sparking a relentless manhunt that will haunt detective Flore Robin and the Perpignan police for years.

metas.name: Cat's Eye
metas.description: By day, sisters Hitomi, Rui and Ai run the popular Cat's Eye Café; by night, they slip into the shadows, executing high-stakes art heists with precision and style.

metas.name: The Murky Stream
metas.description: The fates of a man with a hidden past, a wise and just woman, and an upright man intertwine.

metas.name: Sneaker Wars: Adidas V. Puma
metas.description: Through unprecedented access to both companies, uncover the tale of two feuding brothers, Adi and Rudi Dassler, whose multi-decade rivalry and competition helped shape the modern sportswear industry.

metas.name: Marvel Zombies
metas.description: After the Avengers are overtaken by a zombie plague, a desperate group of survivors discover the key to bringing an end to the super-powered undead, racing across a dystopian landscape and risking life and limb to save their world.

metas.name: Vitória
metas.description: Vitória returns determined to recover her children, Afonso, Matilde, and Francisco, after serving an unjust prison sentence. Her father-in-law, Manuel Mendonça, a powerful and manipulative man, has managed to separate his grandchildren from their mother and will do everything to keep her away from her family. With the help of Jorge, a prestigious lawyer and her first love, Vitória will face the Mendonça empire and fight for what she loves most: her children. Vitória is a story of resilience, courage, and the purest of feelings: a mother's love.

metas.name: Konuşanlar - Disney+
metas.description: “Konuşanlar” brings Hasan Can Kaya's humor and sharp wit to the stage with his comical stories.

metas.name: LEGO Star Wars: Rebuild the Galaxy - Pieces of the Past
metas.description: A new threat rises in the galaxy, and Sig Greebling and Darth Dev must combine their powers of Force Building and Sith Breaking to stop it. Alongside Jedi Bob, Yesi Scala and Servo, they will journey into the deepest corners of Lego Star Wars lore, uncovering pieces of all the galaxies that have come before.

metas.name: Mar afuera
metas.description: Follows Álvaro, a 17-year-old from a wealthy family, whose life takes a downward turn after an accident lands him in a juvenile detention centre. It portrays his experiences and struggles within the correctional facility.

metas.name: Queens
metas.description: Tomatometer 80%
